name: Decorative Materials
tagline: Metal, jaali, mouldings and profiles — the detail layer
description: These are the elements that turn a competent interior into a considered one: a brass reveal at a shadow gap, a CNC jaali filtering light, a profile that finishes a junction cleanly. Small quantities, high visual return.

materials.name: Brass panel / sheet
materials.blurb: Real brass sheet for inlays, reveals and feature cladding
materials.description: Genuine brass in antique, satin or mirror finish, laid as a strip inlay or a full clad panel. Specify lacquered brass unless the client actively wants it to patina.

materials.name: Metal sheet (SS / MS)
materials.blurb: Stainless or mild steel sheet for cladding and fabrication
materials.description: SS 304 in brushed, mirror or PVD-coloured finishes for interior cladding; MS for painted or powder-coated fabricated elements. Both need a board backing to stay flat over large areas.

materials.name: Copper sheet
materials.blurb: Warm reddish metal that develops a living patina
materials.description: Copper ages from bright pink-orange through brown to green if left unlacquered. Beautiful in bar backs and feature panels — as long as the client understands the surface will change.

materials.name: Fluted decorative panel
materials.blurb: Ribbed panels in MDF, WPC, PVC or metal
materials.description: The rib is the point: it catches light, hides a wall's imperfections and gives verticality to a low room. Available in every substrate, so it can go from a bedroom to a balcony.

materials.name: CNC-cut panel
materials.blurb: Custom-routed pattern in MDF, WPC or metal
materials.description: Any pattern that can be drawn can be cut. Used for screens, partitions and pooja unit backdrops, and it works hardest when lit from behind so the cut-out throws a shadow pattern.

materials.name: Jaali
materials.blurb: Perforated screen in the Indian tradition — light, air, privacy
materials.description: The jaali does three jobs at once: it shades, it ventilates and it patterns the light. Stone, timber, GRC and metal versions all work; the geometry matters more than the material.

materials.name: Decorative screen / divider
materials.blurb: Freestanding or fixed screen that zones without walling off
materials.description: Separates a dining area from a living area, or an entry from a room, while keeping light and sightlines. Fixed screens read as architecture; freestanding ones stay flexible.

materials.name: Mirror panel (decorative)
materials.blurb: Bevelled, grooved or antiqued mirror as a wall treatment
materials.description: Mirror used as pattern rather than function — bevelled tiles, grooved sheets, smoked panels. Keep it away from direct sightlines to seating unless the client wants to watch themselves eat.

materials.name: 3D decorative panel
materials.blurb: Relief panels in gypsum, PVC, MDF or stone
materials.description: Moulded or carved relief that reads as texture from across the room. Light it from a grazing angle — front-lit, the relief disappears entirely.

materials.name: Artificial plants & green wall
materials.blurb: Maintenance-free greenery for dark or inaccessible spots
materials.description: Where daylight or access rules out real planting, good artificial foliage does the job — as long as it is UV-stable outdoors and dusted indoors. Mix leaf types; a single species reads as fake.

materials.name: Decorative moulding
materials.blurb: PU, gypsum or timber mouldings for classical detailing
materials.description: Panel mouldings, dado rails and picture frames that give a plain wall proportion and shadow. PU mouldings are light, waterproof and paint exactly like timber.

materials.name: Cornice
materials.blurb: The moulded junction between wall and ceiling
materials.description: Softens the wall-to-ceiling line and hides the crack that always appears there. Gypsum cornices are traditional; PU versions install faster and survive humidity better.

materials.name: Skirting
materials.blurb: Protects the wall base and finishes the floor junction
materials.description: Wood, PVC, aluminium or stone at 75–150 mm — the taller the ceiling, the taller the skirting should be. Shadow-gap aluminium skirting is the current detail of choice in minimal schemes.

materials.name: Aluminium profile / trim
materials.blurb: Edge trims, shadow gaps and tile profiles that finish a junction
materials.description: The small extrusions that make details look deliberate: tile edge trims, shadow-gap sections, T-profiles between materials. Cheap, and the absence of them is instantly visible.
